text:
mika_billing: SolarisAI opened a dispute for INV-SOL-2026-05 saying a planned maintenance window caused traffic to be routed to APAC and they were billed burst instead of using their reserved commit. they want a full reversal + SLA credit.

maria_finance: paste invoice id and any meter lines you received. need to confirm buckets and token counts before we promise anything.

mika_billing: INV-SOL-2026-05 attached. customer excerpt: 'maintenance window 2026-05-11 01:00-02:30 UTC; expected reserved capacity to cover failover traffic; invoice shows large APAC burst line items.'

leo_ops: quick check: maintenance was a control-plane rolling restart in eu-central that caused traffic to rehome to nearest healthy region. customer has reserved commit in eu-central only. routing policy should have attempted intra-tenant reserved nodes first but there was an edge case where maintenance temporarily deregistered node metadata.

sara_prod: was there a deploy or config change during that maintenance? that deregistration bug sounds familiar. we shipped a fix last week but not retroactively for the window.

leo_ops: pulling sanitized meter lines now:
```
meter: customer=solarisai region=ap-southeast bucket=burst tokens=265000 ts=2026-05-11T01:12:09Z
meter: customer=solarisai region=ap-southeast bucket=burst tokens=180000 ts=2026-05-11T01:45:33Z
meter: customer=solarisai region=eu-central bucket=reserved tokens=1_420_000 ts=2026-05-11T00:50:00Z
```

leo_ops: total APAC burst ~445k tokens during maintenance window.

maria_finance: what's their burst unit price?

mika_billing: SolarisAI enterprise burst = $0.0042/token per their addendum.

maria_finance: provisional credit = 445000 * 0.0042 = $1,869.00. recommend we offer a provisional refund for the burst tokens while ops completes an RCA and we determine whether to escalate to SLA credit.

ugo_sales: SolarisAI is scaling quickly; this is a sensitive account. we should be generous on CX here — offer the provisional credit and a one-time courtesy SLA credit (if ops confirms platform error). but keep the provisional cap under $2k unless Fiona signs off.

fiona_cfo: provisional goodwill credit up to $2k is approved for retention. if ops RCA shows our platform error we can convert to formal SLA credit and book accordingly; require full audit export and ticket link in the memo.

sara_prod: i'll log PROD action to add a "maintenance-billing-exception" tag and ensure node metadata deregistration is handled gracefully in future rollouts. PROD-5499 created.

leo_ops: opened OPS-7144 to investigate node metadata deregistration during control-plane restarts and to produce a before/after meter reconciliation. ETA 48h. will attach metering export.

metering-bot: export available s3://redwood-metering/exports/solarisai/2026-05-11/2065432100-export.csv

mika_billing: draft customer message: "Thanks — we see the spike during your maintenance window. We're applying a provisional credit of $1,869 while we complete a technical RCA. Final resolution will be confirmed within 48h and any formal SLA credit applied if the RCA attributes the issue to our platform."

ugo_sales: good. add a sentence offering a short technical debrief and a console review so they can enable multi-region reserved if desired.

maria_finance: include the exact token math and the s3 export link in the note and cc finance lead. i'll prepare the credit memo once OPS-7144 posts the RCA.

fiona_cfo: ensure the provisional credit is flagged as "operational adjustment" in accounting and include OPS ticket link before final posting.

mika_billing: applied provisional credit $1,869 and marked INV-SOL-2026-05 as under review. sent hold note to SolarisAI and scheduled a tech sync.

leo_ops: will post RCA and corrected metering by EOD two days. leaving thread open until OPS-7144 completes. :white_check_mark:
